title: Render workflow transitions with status keys first in CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md
description: Biblicus on Python 0.35.0 with transition_labels configured renders '- open -> Start work (In Progress), Drop (Done), Back to backlog (Backlog)' and 'closed -> Reopen (Discovery)'. Agents need the key they pass to --status. Rust develop with default config renders keys ('- open -> in_progress, closed, backlog'); reproduce with transition_labels in both runtimes first. Wanted: key first, label after, e.g. 'open -> in_progress ("Start work"), closed ("Drop"), backlog'. Gherkin scenario with transition_labels; identical output in both runtimes.
